name: Exponential Subset Sum Disguise
description: Replaces the pairwise distinctness condition (x1 != x2) with an equivalent subset-sum condition using powers of 5. Since exactly k items are chosen, summing to the geometric series sum (which has exactly k ones in base 5) uniquely implies the items must be a distinct permutation of 1..k. This forces the model to mathematically deduce this equivalence to reconstruct the efficient Algorithm X / grouping logic; failing that, it will fall back to a naive subset sum search which will TLE due to the O(t^k) search space.
